CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_x893c3.m1_top_zips AS
WITH trips_agg AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         COUNT(*) AS trips,
         SUM(fare_amount) AS total_fare
  FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
  WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pickup_zip
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
),
busiest_hour AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         hour AS busiest_hour
  FROM (
    SELECT pickup_zip,
           hour(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pickup_zip ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, hour(tpep_pickup_datetime) ASC) AS rn
    FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
    WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY pickup_zip, hour(tpep_pickup_datetime)
  ) tmp
  WHERE rn = 1
),
joined AS (
  SELECT a.pickup_zip,
         a.trips,
         a.total_fare,
         b.busiest_hour
  FROM trips_agg a
  LEFT JOIN busiest_hour b ON a.pickup_zip = b.pickup_zip
)
SELECT pickup_zip,
       trips,
       ROUND(total_fare, 2) AS total_fare,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_fare DESC) AS fare_rank,
       ROUND(
         SUM(total_fare) OVER (ORDER BY total_fare DESC, pickup_zip ASC
                               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
         / SUM(total_fare) OVER () * 100,
         2) AS cumulative_share_pct,
       busiest_hour
FROM joined
QUALIFY fare_rank <= 10
ORDER BY fare_rank;
SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM workspace.exam_x893c3.m1_top_zips
